notes.title: Update - Controller support and much more
notes.notes:
The game was updated to v1.0.086 today and it comes with a lot of new stuff.
It will update automatically if you start Steam.

[h1] Controller support[/h1]
The vehicles can now be controlled with most controllers and joysticks.
Steam and Xbox One controllers have been tested and work fine and so do 90% of the other controllers. But unfortunately the hardware - especially controllers - is totally different and there are some few controllers that don't work.
So if your controller/joystick is incompatible please disable the controller in game.

If you start the game with a connected controller and your player rotates endless you may set the key-bindings of the controller. Quit the game and restart.
On start-screen there's a TAB called 'Input'. Here you can set the key bindings.

[h1]Indoor games[/h1]
In the menu you can select 'Indoor' and a new scene with a big hall get's loaded.
Here you can select from 2 new races and a jump competition.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31459289/2d61f2038638610e64473a203fd3bafb82205fe1.jpg[/img]

[h1]New vehicles[/h1]
Some new vehicles like a double- and a three-decker, a Zeppelin, aHovercraft and some more have been added.
Also there's a new glider wich gets pulled by a rope into the air.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31459289/81258d3de043da0264c107646dd256465024951d.jpg[/img]

[h1]New camera positions[/h1]
In addition to the onboard camera there are 9 new view-positions around the vehicle. You may select them by pressing the keys 1-0.
(1 is the standard onboard position.)

notes.title: Update, Bug and some nice AddOns
notes.notes:
[h1][b]About Controller Support[/b][/h1]
The promised update about controller support is finished 90% and most controllers (i.e. Steam Controller) are working fine!
Right now I'm waiting for a purchased xBox One controller to test and finish the update.
In the end 15 controllers were tested and just 1 doesn't work as expected.
This is caused by problems between Unity 3D and MS Windows and right now I can't do anything on this cause it's hard-coded.
But I'll still release this update to enable controller support for >90% of the controllers and will look to find a solution for the others.
Meanwhile players with non-working controlles can disable the controller support in game.

[h1][b]Little bug in rockets game[/b][/h1]
Unfortunately there's a small bug in the rocket game.
If the game language is set to 'English' it shows distances/heights in feet and speed in miles per hour.
While saving the records it doesn't convert the values to metric system and so the results in the highscore table are wrong. At the moment I fix this manually from time to time.
If you asked yourself, why someone could fly a rocket 16.000 meters, it's cause of this bug.
Of course this will be fixed with the upcoming update very soon!

[h1][b]AddOns[/b][/h1]
A glider that gets pulled by a rope, a slow flying brothers Wright flyer and a floating 'Retro Racer' (some kind of hovercraft) are just a few of the new AddOns that will come with the update. Also an indoor game will be available.
[b]All this of course for free for the game-owners![/b]
